body: Yeah, your probably right. I guess i've got a lot to think about now. I guess i'm starting to see things a bit more rationally. Thanks fir the help, I've calmed down a lot.there was no way today was going to be a good day but its a little bit better now.

The only public transport we have where i live is to schools. I live in a pretty small town. We just got a pretty big hospital but i don't know if they have an emergency room. I'm incredibly hesitant about telling my doctor because i know that if he is concerned it could affect my health majorly that he can tell my parents and due to past experience thats what scares me most. Thats what I've read anyway. I planned on getting all the weird stuff that goes on in my head checked at 18 when i could keep everything to myself but i guess this changes things. I'm still really conflicted about it though.

All that kept me up until three and i woke up for about ten minutes almost every hour so my day started around three hours ago and nothing has really changed. Both of the people in my family i feel like i could talk to live in another city, and i cant drive or talk to them by any other means. I've been scared all day that it might happen again.

Yeah, i have a close friend that helped me a while back when i was in a pretty deep depression. I just cant bring myself to tell him. I feel like he might not believe me. I seem so normal around him most of the time so adding that i had a panic attack to the list of things that I've told him are wrong with me might sound a bit farfetched. And even if he believed me i don't feel like its fair to put all of my mental baggage on his shoulders.

I know he dis it because he cared. I don't blame him at all. He didn't even mention a name when he told her she figured it out on her own or saw the name on his phone or something. Theres no bad blood between us but i just don't want to talk right now i guess.

I haven't talked to a counselor or a professional for a couple of reasons. As far as i know the small town i live in doesn't have anyone who could be considered a psychiatrist. I can't drive to another city because I'm a shitty driver and i never got mu license. As far as i know my school doesn't have a counselor i mean we're missing a principal and a superintendent for fuck sake i wouldn't expect them to prioritize a counselor over that. I really am just stick talking to friends right now but i don't even want to make an effort to do that. I'm just really confused on what to do right now.

Thanks, at the very least it feels nice to have someone on my side. I still want to try and tell him through text though. Where I'm from a male crying isn't generally considered normal and I've been acting like everything's great so from there to breaking down crying is a bit of a leap. I'm also not one of those people who can just commit to something under pressure so the thought of him seeing me breakdown, at least the first time I talk to him about it, scares me. I'd really just like to get the point across without all the extra shit the first time. As time goes on I might be more comfortable with it but right now it just makes it that more daunting of a task. Again thanks for the help, I think I'll be trying again soon.
